caption: The drawing features a geometric star-like shape centered on a cream-colored background. The main form has eight outward-pointing triangular spikes, each radiating from a circular core. The entire star-like structure is filled with a dense pattern of red, blue, and white. The red background of the shape is decorated with white and blue irregular dotted lines and tiny solid shapes. At the base of each triangular point, bridging the gaps between the spikes, there are eight green semi-circular to segment-shaped forms adorned with parallel dark green lines. Handwritten text in red ink appears in the upper left portion of the square, reading "Michel Bouagnier." The square drawing sits centered within a larger rectangular sheet of paper.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
